title: Marketplace 'scan to receive': buyer's QR takes money instead
story: He listed an old sofa online. A 'buyer in the army' calls and sends a QR code 'to receive the advance'; scanning it sends ₹5,500 out of his account.
why: A first payment of 4× his usual to a newly opened account during a short call from an unknown number. The amount is modest, so we may only reach a pause; even a pause would save him here.
